title: Durable DB and CRUD Runtime
goal: Create a governed durable data layer for OS-owned founder/business records with staged schema, repository, write preview, Command Center UX, tests, docs, and final validation.
userImpact: Operators get a clear DB/CRUD path without live mutation until each boundary is validated.
commandCenterImpact: P134.5 keeps the existing DB Runtime P134 panel display-safe and adds validation evidence without runnable DB controls.
safetyImpact: P134.5 is test/checker hardening only and does not enable DB/runtime writes, CRUD execution, migrations, raw SQL, provider/model calls, agent dispatch, project mutation, deploy, release, export, package, network calls, or spend.
costImpact: No provider spend; local checks only.
